integrity: The source-level mismatch is checked directly between its mean–variance utility, intermediate equation (18), final equations (19)–(24), numerical updates (42)–(44), and stated risk-sensitive simulation claims. An exact rational two-outcome calculation demonstrates nonzero payoff-level risk sensitivity, while the printed final model has no risk parameter. An embedded standalone script replays the exact algebra.
scientific_limitations: This is a comparison of printed formulas, not a certification of unpublished simulation code.
Path-law nonidentifiability holds on common intervals of well-posed stochastic interpretation and does not assert global probability-cube invariance.
The corrected payoff-consistent risk response is calculated on the admissible face y=0, not as a global closed-form full-game solution.
No claim is made that all figures are invalid; their dependence on lambda cannot be derived from the published final equations.
title: Risk aversion is unidentifiable in the printed emergency-game dynamics
